svg.text: BEN Engine — BEN Controller Panel Wiring + BEN Pod E/W Wiring — Schreiber AI — IFC Rev B

Left: UL 508A BEN Controls Pro panel (PLCnext + Axioline + edge computer), DIN rows and field terminal groups · Right: BEN Pod E terminal by terminal, Pod W deltas · field wiring Class 2 except relay contacts
BEN CONTROLLER — PRO PANEL (800 × 1000 × 300 mm, NEMA 12, UL 508A, SCCR 10 kA)
ROW A — MAINS IN + 24 VDC (120 VAC section behind finger-safe barrier)
ROW B — PLC + AXIOLINE F I/O (local bus)
ROW C — EDGE COMPUTER, SWITCH, BORDER ROUTER RCPs
ROW D — DOOR: HMI, SELECTOR, RESETS, BEACON
ROW E — FIELD TERMINALS (PT 2,5 push-in, knife-disconnect on every input, shield bar, PE bar)
READ ONLY — can never open the loop
DOR relay NO in series with every
unit enable · opens on PLC STOP
field devices are OUTSIDE the panel · shields landed at the panel end only · knife-disconnects on every group
EPO / fire wires READ the hardwired loop. They can never open it. (sheet 05)
24 VDC Class 2 outside the mains section
18 AWG signal · 16 AWG 24 V · 12 AWG mains
heat ≈ 110 W typ → filter fan 100 m³/h
1. PSU/ORING first, then PLC rack, then edge + switch.
2. Land PE + shield bars; bond to the container grid.
3. Pull field cables to X10..X80; disconnects OPEN.
4. Power up; load PLC project; record PLC_PROJECT_CRC.
5. Close disconnects one group at a time; watch dashboard.
DI1: door reed, dry, HIGH = open
DI2: releasing panel / EPO AUX — MONITOR ONLY
loop-powered from X2 24 V → xmtr → AI+
typical: CDU pressure, flow, UPS output
P1 (+, red tube) → cold aisle tap · P2 (−, blue) → hot aisle tap · SDP810 on board
Relay contacts are Class 1: #14 Cu THHN in their own conduit; everything else Class 2.
Shields land at the Pod end only. Bond the DIN rail (Pod E) / rack rail (Pod W).
Plug X3..X8 LAST, after the edge shows the Pod attested and online.
Label: unit · node id · serial · EUI-64 · cert_id (from the provisioning record).
BEN POD W (wireless) — same board family, what changes
SAME: X3 RTD ×4 · X4 DI1 / DI2 / LEAK · X8 pulse · P1/P2 ΔP tubing · SHT45 on board · LEDs IDENT / LINK
NOT FITTED: X1 RJ45/PoE · X5 4–20 mA · X6 relays · X7 RS-485 (no wired path: Thread only, no outputs)
POWER: BT1 = 2 × AA LiFeS2 (L91) ≈ 1.4 y at 1 Hz, ≈ 4 y at 0.2 Hz (calculated) OR X2 24 VDC → router-eligible
MOUNT: clip-on rack rail 95 × 60 × 28 mm, 2 per rack (front top, rear bottom) · W-X: IP65 115 × 90 × 55 mm, U.FL antenna
RADIO: Thread sleepy end device, 1 s poll on battery · label 'Contains FCC ID / IC' per MGM240P datasheet · ch 25
JOIN: label QR = serial · EUI-64 · PSKd → ben-add-pod.sh → 10 min joiner window → DTLS → mTLS → attest (cert_id)
PROBES: T_in_1 at 1/3, T_in_2 at 2/3 rack height on the front rail; T_out_1/2 same heights on the rear rail
BATTERY: battery_pct < 20 % alarm → swap cells → re-attach + re-attest within 60 s; buffer lost, identity kept
Nothing on a Pod W can switch anything: no outputs. Life safety: DI2 reads an aux contact only.
panel PE bar → container bonding grid (#6 Cu green) · shield bar isolated from PE, bonded at one point
Life-safety contact — MONITOR ONLY · relay contacts (Class 1)
